foundations: AIP has a tenant-scoped one-time Handoff authority with exact Task, TaskRun and AgentInstance refs, bearer-token hashing, expiry, receiver reauthorization, CAS terminal transitions and append-only events

AIP has canonical provider Usage Receipt, Adjustment and exact-subject Attribution contracts with persistent authority, deterministic provider-receipt identity and unknown-without-fabricated-zero semantics
the growth solution pack declares EffectReviewRef and a policy-level EffectReviewSchema requiring metric definitions, evidence refs, assumptions and uncertainty
the Workshop shell and evidence client preserve partial and unknown as explicit states rather than replacing missing values with zero

findings.finding: W6-03 through W6-08 are all unchecked, so there are no completed creator, price or customer batch/action outcomes on which W6-09 can build partial, usage, effect or handoff closure.

no shared item outcome algebra, immutable attempt identity, count-conservation reducer, cancellation semantics or domain mapping normalizes creator, price and customer eligible/accepted/applied/failed/unknown/reconciled/skipped states. Generic UI partial is only a display state.

Usage authority exists, but current provider bridge is attached to the model/LLM path; no automatic bridge binds creator discovery/action, price research/action or customer channel Action provider receipts to canonical lineage and batch item attempts.

no three-domain attribution policy maps measured, estimated or unknown usage to exact Module, Batch, item, TaskRun, AgentRun, capability, account, budget and tenant refs with weights, adjustments and settlement reconciliation.
EffectReviewRef and EffectReviewSchema are declared assets only; no canonical EffectReview contract instance, PostgreSQL store, service, API, revision lifecycle, RLS, CAS or Receipt authority exists.

no versioned maturity-window policy defines eligible observation sources, event-time cutoff, attribution window, late data, minimum sample, baseline/control, censoring, freshness, confidence, re-evaluation schedule or invalidation semantics per domain. The unrelated platform maturity-level page is not effect maturity.

no compiler binds action and outcome Receipts, Observation originals, metric definitions, assumptions, uncertainty, attribution method and ImpactPreview to a review; correlation cannot be promoted to causation or durable memory without these refs.

generic Handoff is AgentInstance-to-AgentInstance inside a canonical TaskRun; no Module/Case/Batch-to-TaskRun bridge, purpose-to-policy compiler or domain command maps creator, price and customer scoped refs into the generic envelope.

the generic Handoff lifecycle supports issue, consume, revoke and expire, but no accept, reject, request-more, requestedOutcome, return Receipt or EffectReview feedback contract exists for cross-Module collaboration.

no creator, price or customer business view exposes item partial conservation, measured/estimated/unknown Usage, effect maturity countdown and evidence, Handoff decision timeline or request-more intervention.
W5 and W6-03 through W6-08 are not GREEN, production adapters are absent and no real outcome cohort exists; operational effect or handoff closure cannot be claimed.

verification.interpretation: generic one-time Handoff, Usage Receipt and partial-display foundations are stable, while three-domain item closure, automatic Usage binding, EffectReview authority and maturity windows are absent
